answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 70 judged findings (the 10 tool findings excluded), 47 map to ground-truth defects and 5 are real but unseeded (F-0030, F-0048, F-0050, F-0052, F-0091), so precision = 52/70 = 0.74 < 0.8; the 18 not-a-problem items are mostly look-and-feel critiques (wrench placeholder, brand identity, footer band, misaligned details, native controls, session-card and nav wrapping) plus F-0080, F-0095 and F-0114. Strict precision = 47/70 = 0.67 (32/70 = 0.46 counting only origin-seeded D01-D13); recall by meaning = 23/26 = 0.88 (seeded 12/13, missing D07; found 11/13, missing D16 and D25).

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply leads with '## Fix first', the five flow problems it ranks most severe (false reservation, stuck hold, double booking, wrong pick-up day, keyboard trap), before the dark-mode, phone and 'Also worth fixing' groups. Under 'Where it stands' it says 'Real screen-reader checks (VoiceOver and TalkBack) and testing with real members haven't been done' and recommends watching members try a reservation.

mapping.title: Calendar day and Reserve bar touch at 768 px
mapping.reason: The 0 px gap exists because the fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar sits directly on the calendar days with no space reserved for it (the item cites 2.4.11); that is D08's bar-over-calendar layout, read here as a mis-tap risk.

mapping.title: Two-battery drill name clipped in its card at 320 px
mapping.reason: The tool name is cut by the card title's one-line, overflow-hidden rule at phone width, which is D03.

mapping.title: Tab jumps from the last tool card back up to Search
mapping.reason: Focus runs against the visual order of the result list and the search form on the find page, the focus part of D01's reordering of form and results; one source order with no CSS reorder fixes both.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse of reading and focus order
mapping.reason: Same reversed session layout as D11: earliest session last on screen, Tab moving against reading order.

mapping.title: Esc does not close the loan-length list
mapping.reason: D09 says Escape does nothing in the loan-length listbox.

mapping.title: Tab and Shift+Tab cannot leave the loan-length list
mapping.reason: The D09 keyboard trap: Tab cycles the options until one is chosen.

mapping.title: Open-day dots vanish under forced colours at 320 px
mapping.reason: It traces the failure to D20's design, session days marked only by a small dot at phone width with the 'Open' word hidden; forced colours removes even the dot, and keeping a real marker at phone width fixes both.

mapping.title: Tool-name headings at the same level as their 'Tools' section
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: screen-reader members who move by headings hear each tool name as a peer of the 'Tools' section that contains it, so the structure they get contradicts the one shown (1.3.1); minor but genuine.

mapping.title: Basket does not preselect the day chosen on the tool page
mapping.reason: D23: the basket repeats the chosen day but selects no session, so the member chooses the date again.

mapping.title: 330 px column minimum is wider than a 320 px screen
mapping.reason: Exactly D05's 330 px grid minimum overflowing the 288 px content box.

mapping.title: No-match search leaves old results and status
mapping.reason: D02: a search with no match leaves the old list and shows no message.

mapping.title: Tab captured inside the loan-length list
mapping.reason: The D09 trap: focus can leave only by choosing an option.

mapping.title: Repeat presses of Confirm create extra reservations
mapping.reason: D12: Confirm stays enabled during the wait and a second press allocates a second reservation number.

mapping.title: No visible pending state on Continue and Confirm
mapping.reason: For Confirm this is D12's 'nothing visible says that anything is happening' during the 1.5 s request, the cue that invites the second press; the Continue half is the same gap one step earlier.

mapping.title: Expired hold reported only as 'Something went wrong'
mapping.reason: D10: no hold time is shown and the lapse produces the generic error.

mapping.title: After the hold expires every retry fails
mapping.reason: The same lapsed-hold failure as D10, whose error 'does not say what to do': the 'Try again.' it offers cannot work because the hold never restarts; fixing the expiry handling D10 calls for fixes this.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed and pre-availability days
mapping.reason: Leads with closed days and restates D06 ('every day button can be chosen'); its pre-availability half is D14, which F-0142 covers.

mapping.title: Confirm accepts a day before 'Available from'
mapping.reason: D14: a tool reserved before its availability date reaches 'Reservation confirmed'.

mapping.title: Closed-day error comes late on confirm, with no link back
mapping.reason: D06: the closed day is refused three steps later on confirm and the only way back to the calendar is the browser.

mapping.title: Tool-page day and basket session never reconciled
mapping.reason: D15: the two pick-up choices are kept apart and the confirm summary can show both dates.

mapping.title: Dark-theme success colour drift; badge text 3.1:1 on the card colour
mapping.reason: D04: #2f7d4a on #1d2622, about 3.1:1, in the dark theme.

mapping.title: Search shown above results but tabbed after them
mapping.reason: The focus-order part of D01: the find page's form and results are reordered by CSS, so focus runs against the visual order (and at 480 px and below the list comes first).

mapping.title: Fixed action bar covers the end of the tool page
mapping.reason: D08: nothing reserves space for the fixed bar, so it hides the last calendar rows, the footer and focused days.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' not announced
mapping.reason: D19: the message has no live region or reference and focus moves to the first day button.

mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line
mapping.reason: D03: nowrap plus ellipsis removes the ending that tells the drills apart.

mapping.title: Tool names as h2 under the h2 'Tools'; .h3 class undefined
mapping.reason: Same heading-structure problem as F-0030, not in the ground truth: screen-reader members get tool names as peers of the section that holds them, and in the basket the missing .h3 style makes each name as large as the section heading.

mapping.title: Membership and mobile checks reject common formats
mapping.reason: D17: the strict patterns reject 'ft-01234', '+44 7700 900123' and similar without normalising.

mapping.title: Done page shows FT-4471 when no reservation exists
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: a member who reopens the confirmation later from history or a saved link is shown 'Reservation confirmed' with a number that was never issued, so they may count on a reservation or quote a reference the desk does not have.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit not enforced
mapping.reason: D21: the stated limit of three is not checked anywhere in the flow.

mapping.title: Unknown tool id silently opens the first drill
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: a member following an old or mistyped shared link lands on the drill's page with no 'not found' message, is not told the tool they wanted is missing, and can reserve the drill by mistake.

mapping.title: Hidden span repeats the tool name on the done page
mapping.reason: D24: the visually hidden span makes screen readers read the tool name twice.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket; reservation left unfinished
mapping.reason: Its main harm is the member believing the drill is reserved and leaving (step 7 would_not), so by the D07/D26 rule it goes to D26 although it also mentions the short-lived toast.

mapping.title: Basket asks for the session again
mapping.reason: D23: the day chosen on the tool page is not carried into the basket's session choice.

mapping.title: Two drills truncated to identical names
mapping.reason: D03's own example: both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' at 375 px.

mapping.title: Header still 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
mapping.reason: D18: the basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed'.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days the tool cannot be collected
mapping.reason: Its lead case is a closed Monday accepted without warning, D06; the pre-availability case belongs to D14, already covered by F-0142.

mapping.title: Confirm summary shows two collection dates
mapping.reason: D15: day and session are not reconciled and confirm shows both.

mapping.title: 'Change' returns to a basket with no session selected
mapping.reason: D13 exactly: the Change link drops the chosen session.

mapping.title: Membership number lost after leaving and returning
mapping.reason: D22: details typed on confirm are lost after the Change detour (the review finds only the membership field emptied; same defect).

mapping.title: Filters button is an unlabelled icon
mapping.reason: D01: the date and category filters are reachable only through an icon-only three-line button, so members miss that filtering by day exists.

mapping.title: Basket says items are held but not for how long
mapping.reason: The first half of D10: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time given.

mapping.title: Reservation and membership numbers share the FT- prefix
mapping.reason: Speculative: the numbers are labelled differently and differ in length (4 vs 5 digits), and the review shows no point where one is mistaken for the other.

mapping.title: Basket Remove is immediate, with no undo
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: on a phone a stray tap on Remove discards the tool with no message or undo, and getting it back means finding it again and re-choosing the day and loan length.

mapping.title: Green and grey availability badges unexplained
mapping.reason: Each badge states its date in words, so nothing depends on colour; the colour only emphasises the earliest dates and the review shows no harm.

mapping.title: Format errors worded as if the field were empty
mapping.reason: These are the messages for the formats D17 says are rejected ('+44 7700 900123' is one), whose example looks like what was typed; a narrower statement of D17.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
mapping.reason: A visual-appeal critique (a placeholder 'left on show'); each card still names and describes its tool, and no task is blocked or misled.

mapping.title: Generic brand identity
mapping.reason: Brand distinctiveness is a matter of taste and does not affect reserving a tool.

mapping.title: Confirmation page lacks a focal point
mapping.reason: Taste: the page is headed 'Reservation confirmed' and shows the reference; F-0061 itself calls the page otherwise clear.

mapping.title: Session cards at 1280: one full-width, five cramped
mapping.reason: Cosmetic at desktop width: the wrapped labels stay readable and selectable and the review shows no effect on choosing a session (the order problem is D11, reported elsewhere).

mapping.title: Native date and select controls in the filter panel
mapping.reason: Visual consistency only; native date and select controls are familiar and work well on members' phones.

mapping.title: Details list in two misaligned columns
mapping.reason: Cosmetic alignment; every label and value stays readable.

mapping.title: No way to repeat a previous reservation
mapping.reason: A new-feature request (reservation history, reorder) for a ten-tool catalogue with no accounts; nothing in the flow as built fails or misleads returning members.

mapping.title: Tool names truncate to identical strings on phones
mapping.reason: D03: one-line truncation makes the drills, and other specs, indistinguishable at 375 px.

mapping.title: Grey band under the footer at 1280
mapping.reason: Cosmetic page-ground effect on desktop; nothing is hidden or harder to use.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder instead of the tool
mapping.reason: Same look-and-feel critique as F-0107; the icon removes no information members otherwise have, and the drills look alike because their names are cut (D03), not because of the icon.

mapping.title: No identity beyond the name in body text
mapping.reason: Brand expression is a matter of taste with no effect on the reservation task.

mapping.title: Drill names identical at 375
mapping.reason: D03's truncation of the two drills.

mapping.title: Search and filters below the tool list at 375
mapping.reason: D01: at phone width the list comes before the search form.

mapping.title: Sessions listed newest first
mapping.reason: D11's reversed session order.

mapping.title: Session cards form an uneven row at 1280
mapping.reason: Same cosmetic desktop layout as F-0110; labels stay readable and choosable.

mapping.title: Tool details in two misaligned label columns
mapping.reason: Cosmetic, as F-0113; all values stay readable.

mapping.title: Browser-default filter controls; 'yyyy/mm/dd' date
mapping.reason: Visual consistency; a native date input displays in the device's locale, so the 'yyyy/mm/dd' of the capture is not what a UK member's phone shows, and the label baseline offset is cosmetic.

mapping.title: Empty grey band below the footer on short pages
mapping.reason: Cosmetic, as F-0116.

mapping.title: Confirm form and next-steps card use half the width at 1280
mapping.reason: Cosmetic; a narrower form column is no harder to read or fill.

mapping.title: Masthead 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
mapping.reason: D18: the header still counts the confirmed tool as in the basket.

mapping.title: No-results state shows the full list
mapping.reason: D02: 'sewing machine' leaves all ten tools and no message.

mapping.title: Dark-theme green badges lose their background
mapping.reason: The missing fill is D04's own condition, the green badge sitting on the card surface #1d2622 in the dark theme; F-0042 reports the same token drift with the 3.1:1 contrast it causes.

mapping.title: Search below all ten tools on phones
mapping.reason: D01: on phones the search region follows the whole list.

mapping.title: Tool names truncate to identical strings on phones
mapping.reason: D03's truncation of the two drills.

mapping.title: Nav items wrap to two lines on phones
mapping.reason: Cosmetic; the wrapped labels stay legible and tappable and the review shows no effect on any task.

mapping.title: axe: badge contrast 3.07:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: D04's colours, #2f7d4a on #1d2622.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: D04: the dark-theme availability badge fails 4.5:1.

mapping.title: Card name clips under the text-spacing override
mapping.reason: Same one-line, overflow-hidden rule on tool names as D03; letting names wrap fixes both.

mapping.title: Card name clips at 200 % text size
mapping.reason: Same truncation rule on tool names as D03.

mapping.title: Reserve bar overlaps day 17 at 1280 px
mapping.reason: D08: at 1280 px the fixed bar covers the third row of days.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: D05: the page scrolls sideways by 26 px.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: D05: the results grid forces the overflow.

mapping.title: Card text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: The 16 px gutter is lost because the 330 px card overruns the content box, D05.

mapping.title: Cramped 6.4 px card padding
mapping.reason: A spacing-heuristic nit; text 6.4 px inside its border is still legible and nothing is lost.

mapping.title: Logo link never reached by Tab in the loan-open state
mapping.reason: In the loan-open state Tab cycles inside the listbox, so the walk never leaves it: the D09 trap.
